sourceEntry: 2026-10-22 — Native PDF viewer and spreadsheet previews (local source)
releaseSummary: PDFs open in the browser's own viewer on desktop (search, print, thumbnails); phones and tablets keep the built-in page viewer. CSV and Excel (.xlsx) attachments can now be previewed as a grid, with sheet tabs, from admin email and helpdesk tickets.

moduleImpact.notes: Updated as part of Native PDF viewer and spreadsheet previews (local source).

migrationNotes: No manual data migration is required for this release.
